title: AccountSettingKey
description:
Allowed platform-level setting keys. The min_cash_* keys are mutually
exclusive; set one mode value and clear the others via delete_keys. The
buffer_cash_* keys are decimal fractions in [0, 1] and must satisfy
min <= target <= max. A request touching any of them must address all
three, either as a setting or in delete_keys; a partial write is
rejected.
